name: Task Tinder
doc: The agent suggests tasks as a card stack: swipe right to accept (queued as a Kanban card that runs), left to reject (kept, sinks, may come back later).

modality.title: Task Tinder
modality.doc: Swipe the agent's task suggestions: right = do it, left = not now
